name: Graft
description: Builds a local, always-fresh graph of your codebase as linked markdown and serves it to coding agents over MCP and a CLI, so they spend fewer tokens and tool calls finding code.

skills.name: Find Code
skills.description: Returns ranked graph nodes with file:line and inlined source for a natural-language question.

skills.name: File API Surface
skills.description: Lists every signature in a file without bodies.

skills.name: Trace Calls
skills.description: Shows who depends on a symbol, or what it depends on, several levels deep.

skills.name: Repo Map
skills.description: Summarizes directory clusters, hubs, and hotspots of an unfamiliar repo.

skills.name: Freshness Check
skills.description: Reports whether the local graph has drifted from the code.
